fusions.name: Colony on the Cut
fusions.desc: Flicks a sea-whip frond at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Feeding Fronds
fusions.desc: Sweeps a stinging frond around you that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Gorgonian Grove
fusions.desc: Grows a stand of sea whips around you for 8 seconds; it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a polyp buds on your lash, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per polyp (18% at full). Unfed, a polyp fades every 6 seconds.
